source_text:
18.10 Τὰ κρίματα Κυρίου ἀληθινὰ, δε
δικαιωμένα ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό. ̓Αναγκαῖον τοῖς δύο στίχοις τοῖς προτέ ροις τὸν τρίτον
προσέθηκε· τὰ γὰρ τοῦ Θεοῦ κρίματα, τοῖς μὲν ἁμαρτάνουσι καὶ παρα βάταις φοβερὰ
καὶ ἀποζητητέα καθέστηκεν· τοῖς δὲ ἐργαζομένοις τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸν νόμον καὶ
φυλάττουσι παντὸς πλούτου τιμιώτερα, διὰ τὴν ἐλπίδα τῆς ἀμοιβῆς, ἀλλὰ μὴν καὶ
πάσης ἡδονῆς γλυκύτερα φαίνεται.
pass_a_gloss: The judgments of-Lord true, having-been-justified upon the same. Necessary to-the two verses to-the former the third he-added; the for of-the God judgments, to-the on-the-one-hand sinning and transgressors fearful and to-be-sought-out have-been-established; to-the and working of-the God the law and keeping of-every wealth more-honorable, through the hope of-the recompense, but indeed also of-every pleasure sweeter they-appear.
pass_b_english: “The judgments of the Lord are true, justified together” (Psalm 18:10).

It was necessary that he added the third verse to the two former; for the judgments of God, for those who sin and transgress, have been established as fearful and to-be-sought-out; but for those who work the law of God and keep it they appear more honorable than all wealth, because of the hope of the recompense, and indeed also sweeter than every pleasure.

choices.term: τοῖς μὲν ἁμαρτάνουσι … φοβερὰ … τοῖς δὲ … γλυκύτερα
choices.english: fearful for those who sin … sweeter for those who keep
choices.why: Same judgments, two effects. Not ‘judgments are only sweet’ or ‘only fearful’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
